title: Tech Note: Getting Started with ODBC Driver for 4D Server

historical_commentary.text: This note covers setting up the ODBC Driver for 4D Server on both Windows and Macintosh platforms, using the Windows 32-bit ODBC administrator and Intersolve's ODBC Data Source Administrator on Mac. ODBC connectivity allowed external applications to query 4D Server data. The 4D ODBC Driver has evolved significantly; modern 4D provides ODBC Pro and native SQL support (introduced in v11 SQL) that supersede this early configuration approach.
related_updates: 4D introduced a built-in SQL engine in v11 SQL (~2007)
Modern 4D ODBC Driver has been updated and reconfigured for current operating systems
Intersolve's ODBC tools are no longer used; standard OS-level ODBC management has replaced them
